error[ZBX-E0566]: Google refused to impersonate the service account
  cause  the federated identity may not impersonate
         zbx-pull@zbx-demo.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  status 403
  google PERMISSION_DENIED
  perm   iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken
  fix    grant the pool's principal roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser on the service account
